sites.evidence_type: N-terminal HA epitope; parallel surface-display screen
sites.functional_impact_measured: Surface immunostaining PME 261.5 ± 14.1 (HA immunostaining, Tedman deep receptor scanning)
sites.rationale: Experimentally validated N-terminal HA epitope insertion (after signal-peptide cleavage where present); surface expression read out by HA immunostaining in Tedman et al. deep receptor scanning.

sources.citation: Tedman et al., Efficient experimental characterization of the GPCRome via deep receptor scanning, Nat Commun 2026 (bioRxiv 2025.09.19.677468, PMC12458215)
sources.claim: N-terminal HA epitope inserted per receptor; surface expression read out by HA immunostaining in a pooled GPCRome deep-receptor-scanning screen.

literature_notes: All five ledger lines were evaluated. L1 and L2 (PMC10895044) report a C-terminal HA tag on full-length OPN1LW expressed in AAV vectors and mouse retina; the C-terminus (residues 326–364) is INTRACELLULAR per the authoritative topology landmarks, so this tag is cytoplasmic and cannot serve as an extracellular surface tag. L3 and L4 (PMC10362383) report a C-terminal myc tag on OPN1LW (ADVM-062.myc) expressed in NHP retina; the same intracellular C-terminus applies. L5 (PMC12704717) describes a C-terminal 1D4 tag on 'human green cone opsin' — that is OPN1MW (medium-wave/green), not OPN1LW (long-wave/red); it does not qualify as evidence for OPN1LW. The extracellular N-terminus (residues 1–54) is present and in principle accessible, but no ledger line reports any tag there. No ledger line supports an extracellular tag insertion for OPN1LW; sites = [].

literature_other_positions.note: C-terminal HA tag fused in-frame to full-length OPN1LW; the C-terminus (residues 326–364) is intracellular per topology landmarks, so this is a cytoplasmic tag, not a surface tag.
C-terminal myc tag on OPN1LW (ADVM-062.myc) expressed in NHP retina; same intracellular C-terminus, confirmed by anti-myc immunohistochemistry of transduced cones.
